misconceptions.description: Building charts or writing the headline before cleaning and summarizing the data, so the story may not be supported by the numbers
misconceptions.trigger: learner styles a chart or fixes a headline before validating the underlying data
misconceptions.feedback: Work in order: clean the data, summarize with a pivot, choose the chart, then write a claim-first headline tied to the verified numbers.

misconceptions.description: Publishing a data story where the headline number and the chart total do not match, leaving the pipeline out of sync
misconceptions.trigger: learner ships a story whose headline figure differs from the chart or pivot total
misconceptions.feedback: Reconcile the headline, pivot, and chart so they report the same number. A mismatch signals a range, filter, or stale-pivot problem to fix first.

misconceptions.description: Letting an AI tool invent the dataset, the finding, or the chart choice instead of using it to critique the learner's own verified work
misconceptions.trigger: learner asks AI to produce the data story rather than review it
misconceptions.feedback: Keep the data and the claim yours. Use AI to critique a draft against your real numbers, accepting or rejecting each suggestion with reasons.

misconceptions.description: Spending formatting effort on a polished slide before running the three-way match, which makes a wrong story look more credible.
misconceptions.trigger: learner styles the chart and headline before confirming headline, pivot cell, and bar height agree
misconceptions.feedback: Reconcile first, format last. A crisp chart can still carry a stale-pivot mismatch, and polish makes the wrong number more persuasive, not more correct. Run the headline=pivot=bar check, then style.

misconceptions.description: Assuming that because each pipeline stage (clean, pivot, chart, narrate) worked alone, the assembled pipeline works together.
misconceptions.trigger: learner skips end-to-end checks after assembling individually verified stages
misconceptions.feedback: Integration introduces failures no single stage could: a refreshed pivot feeding a stale chart, a headline written from an earlier draft. Verify the assembled story end to end, not just each part in isolation.
